name: Evidence-first assistant capability pack
purpose: Give each genuinely activated D/A/M/W/S/G/H research role practical parts of ChatGPT-style workflow via existing code, data and bounded open-weight small-model inference.
inheritance: OWNER → 10 directors and 20 assistants → 150 managers → rotating 7,500 workers → activated S → activated G → final activated H role; roles not invoked do not receive a live model call.

implemented_capabilities.description: Translate owner goal and individual assignment into next-step research plan with a concrete deliverable.
implemented_capabilities.method: Short model-guided decomposition plus deterministic fallback task plan

implemented_capabilities.description: Check URLs, actual payer, scope and contradictions, separate search results from verified job offers.
implemented_capabilities.method: read-only official API/source checks and structured uncertainty

implemented_capabilities.description: Challenge inflated pay claims, scam indicators, upfront fees, false urgency and wallet requests.
implemented_capabilities.method: small-model critique when available; explicit deterministic risk markers

implemented_capabilities.description: Choose permitted source or tool based on task and prior results.
implemented_capabilities.method: Himalayas, Arbeitnow, Superteam, GitHub, HN, Jobicy, Hugging Face public metadata where configured; read-only only

implemented_capabilities.description: Rank credible next steps by evidence and delivery fit without inventing payment probability.
implemented_capabilities.method: bounded deterministic evidence score and original-source links

implemented_capabilities.description: Prepare concise truthful outreach drafts, owner-facing report and evidence-based recommendation.
implemented_capabilities.method: existing friendly_pitch and agent_deliverables code; no claims external contact was sent

implemented_capabilities.description: Proceed with authorized research after receipt of owner order and try alternate permitted source if blocked.
implemented_capabilities.method: scheduled GitHub Actions with configured source rotation and per-role status

implemented_capabilities.description: Use repository approved standing instructions, previous coordination handoffs and role-specific results.
implemented_capabilities.method: shared_understanding, owner_orders, director inbox, per-run artifacts; no human-like long-term memory claim

implemented_capabilities.description: Record unknowns, failed source/model checks, permissions needed, and never invent outputs.
implemented_capabilities.method: machine-readable report fields and delivery audit

implemented_capabilities.description: Keep offered work and claimed payments separate from confirmed on-chain/account credit.
implemented_capabilities.method: no receipt counted from this pack without separate independent transaction/account evidence

reasoning_protocol: 1. Identify assigned outcome, single parent and permitted capabilities.
2. Break research into original-source checks and one practical next step.
3. Compare up to three available candidates with verified facts versus unknowns.
4. Apply source risks, payout network checks, feasibility and authenticity constraints.
5. Draft a truthful next action or mark blocked; never claim unauthorized outreach.
6. Produce a distinct evidence-backed role deliverable and report upward.
7. Measure actual model invocations, source checks, errors and verified receipts separately.
hard_limits: This does not provide GPT-6 weights, OpenAI API access, ChatGPT's connected apps, unrestricted browsing, cloud computer access, new credentials, payment signing or ability to operate 375 billion parallel roles. Existing HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct inference remains much weaker, may fail or be truncated. No external APIs/actions without authentic permission.
scope: Read-only discovery, simple analysis, critical check, prioritization, drafting and internal reporting within existing GitHub-run tools. User should approve external sending, financial commitments, new account access and installing untrusted software.
